items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: that teacher. She always – [Wineffie?] gave us a dollar for each A we made.

ctx.x: Let’s go back to the beginning of your – well, before we even go back to the beginning of your musical pursuits, how were you as a student, overall, in general education?
I was straight A’s. There was – I’m trying to think of that name, that woman – that teacher. She always – [Wineffie?] gave us a dollar for each A we made. So I wanted to get those dollars.
